name: evk-datalogger
description: EVK4 event camera datalogger with HTTP API control (runtime biases, rate limiter, circular buffer) and an MJPEG live-stream server (viewfinder).
author: Y2Kmeltdown

arguments.name: file_length
arguments.description: Seconds before rolling over to a new raw recording file.

arguments.name: rate_limit
arguments.description: Initial hardware event-rate limit (events/second). 0 = unlimited. Adjustable at runtime via the HTTP API.

arguments.name: diff_on
arguments.description: Initial diff_on camera bias (ON-event contrast threshold, 0-255). Adjustable at runtime via the HTTP API.

arguments.name: diff_off
arguments.description: Initial diff_off camera bias (OFF-event contrast threshold, 0-255). Adjustable at runtime via the HTTP API.

arguments.name: buffer_max_age
arguments.description: Circular buffer cap: maximum seconds of raw history retained (0 = buffer off). Adjustable at runtime via the HTTP API.

arguments.name: buffer_max_bytes
arguments.description: Circular buffer cap: maximum bytes of raw history retained (0 = buffer off). Adjustable at runtime via the HTTP API.

arguments.name: stream_quality
arguments.description: JPEG quality for the live stream (1-100).

sockets.name: events
sockets.description: Decoded DVS events: published by event_based_camera, consumed by evk_mjpeg_server and the dashboard backend.

sockets.name: triggers
sockets.description: Trigger events published by event_based_camera (see trigger_test.py).

sockets.name: mjpeg
sockets.description: Viewfinder MJPEG stream plus /api/settings and /api/streaming. Port allocated by eventide at install time; reachable at /proxy/evk-datalogger/mjpeg/.

sockets.name: http_api
sockets.description: Datalogger HTTP API: recording status, runtime camera biases, rate limiter, and circular buffer caps. Port allocated by eventide at install time. Recording itself is always on (built without --record-toggle).
